data.name: Jonathan
data.gender_notes: Jonathan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yehonatan: Yahu, 'Yahweh', + natan, 'has given'. Its root is Hebrew y-h-w-n-t-n. Jonathan, son of King Saul (1 Samuel 18). Jonathan is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh has given”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jonathan expresses “Yahweh has given”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yehonatan: Yahu, 'Yahweh', + natan, 'has given'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jonathan total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
